Bill history page confirming the House third-reading date and tally; Martinez is not on the sponsor list, so her act is the vote.

rows.reasoning: Martinez voted Y on final House passage of SB 1165 (2022), a single-subject bill whose operative section provides that "Athletic teams or sports designated for "females", "women" or "girls" may not be open to students of the male sex." That matches the rung that would "require transgender athletes to compete only on teams matching their biological sex assigned at birth." The bill expressly does not restrict eligibility for teams designated "males", "men" or "boys" or "coed" or "mixed", which excludes the rung that would "completely ban all transgender athletes from competing in any organized sports competitions", and it offers no documentation or case-by-case path, which excludes the rungs below it; the 31-24 tally is not near-unanimous.
